text:
The dish looks like eggplant parmigiana, with tomato sauce, melted cheese, eggplant slices, and what may be a zucchini piece.

For scale, the plate spans about 350 px, so I treated it as a roughly 26 cm dinner plate, which gives about 13 px per cm. The food covers about 230 px by 230 px, or roughly 15 cm by 12 cm at its widest, though it is irregular and not fully covering that area. I estimated a footprint of about 100 cm² with an average thickness of about 2 cm. That gives about 200 cm³, and at roughly 0.8 g/cm³ after allowing for gaps, about 160-200 g of food. I settled on 190 g.

Eggplant parmigiana runs about 150 kcal per 100 g, since the cheese and oil add up. At 190 g, that comes to about 285 kcal, which I rounded to 280.
